description: Source code implementing the Bbr2StartupMode class for TCP congestion control in QUIC, including methods for managing startup phase, congestion events, and debug state export.

classes.name: Bbr2StartupMode
classes.description: Implements the startup mode for BBRv2 congestion control, managing bandwidth growth, congestion events, and state export.

methods.name: Bbr2StartupMode
methods.description: Constructor initializing startup mode, incrementing slowstart count and setting pacing and cwnd gains.

methods.name: Enter
methods.description: Method called upon entering startup mode; should not be called as it triggers a bug.

methods.name: Leave
methods.description: Stops the slowstart duration timer and clears bandwidth low during exit from startup.

methods.name: OnCongestionEvent
methods.description: Handles congestion events during startup, determining whether to transition to drain or continue startup based on bandwidth and losses.

methods.name: CheckExcessiveLosses
methods.description: Checks for excessive packet losses to exit startup early.

methods.name: ExportDebugState
methods.description: Exports internal debug state for diagnostics.
